model_system: uniformly precessing noncollinear kagome antiferromagnet interfaced with a normal metal (NM/NCAF bilayer)

key_params.order_parameter: SO(3) rotation matrix R, expanded via small Gibbs vector r
key_params.driving: uniform ac magnetic field at spin-wave resonance
key_params.geometry: NM taken as a perfect spin sink; negligible spin backflow
key_params.approximation: uniform dynamics; spatial gradients neglected for Onsager/spin-pumping derivation; small deviations around equilibrium |r| << 1

headline_claim: The three spin-wave bands of a kagome antiferromagnet pump ac spin currents with mutually orthogonal spin polarizations.
replication_difficulty: medium — mostly an analytical effective-action/Onsager derivation, but reproducing the kagome-mode polarization result requires working through appendices and mode analysis.
